y3p9tc:295: A deep technical article co-authored by Martin Fowler and Kent Beck, using Bayer's PRINCE (Preclinical Information Center) system as a case study, systematically articulating an architectural methodology for building reliable Agentic AI systems. The article details a three-stage evolution from Search → Ask → Do, a multi-Agent orchestration architecture based on LangGraph, a three-layer reflection mechanism (process reflection, data reflection, draft reflection), and production-grade error handling and evaluation systems. It is one of the most complete public case studies of Harness Engineering and Context Engineering in enterprise-scale AI systems.
